verdict.rationale: Copilot's agent mode is documented to 'plan, explore, and execute work autonomously' and chat can 'explain concepts' in the editor, suggesting some autonomous exploration without manual file picking, but there is no explicit documentation of a whole-codebase mapping/explanation feature or automatic codebase-wide indexing for this purpose. missing for 10: explicit docs on full-repo semantic indexing/mapping, hands-on evidence of explaining an entire unfamiliar codebase, and confirmation that no manual context selection is needed.
